tokenRejected: GitLab rejected the token of this connection (401).
readOnlyToken: The token of this connection cannot post: it needs the api scope.
forbidden: GitLab refused the comment (403): the token’s user may lack the Reporter role, or the discussion is locked.
notFound: GitLab did not find this merge request, or the token cannot see it.
positionRejected: GitLab could not place the comment on this line. Reload the PR and try again.
rateLimited: GitLab limits how many comments can be posted per minute. Try again in {seconds} s.
redirect: GitLab answered with a redirect — check the connection’s base URL.
unavailable: GitLab is unavailable; the comment was not confirmed. Check the merge request before posting again.
noToken: Connect a token for this host in Settings → GitLab Integration to post comments.
hostNotConnected: No GitLab connection for this host. Add one in Settings → GitLab Integration.
bodyTooLong: The comment is too long for GitLab.
fileNotInDiff: This file is not part of the merge request’s diff.
lineNotInDiff: This line is not part of the merge request’s diff.
diffNotReady: GitLab is still preparing this merge request’s diff. Try again in a minute.
diffChanged: The merge request changed since this diff was loaded. Reload the PR and post again.
replyTargetNotFound: The comment you are replying to was not found on GitLab.
failed: Couldn’t post the comment to GitLab.
